nodes.label: The Price of Dawn
nodes.description: D&D 5e campaign of moral reckoning set in Varenhold; central dilemma of ritual sacrifice vs consent

nodes.label: Varenhold
nodes.description: City in artificial twilight for fifty years; grey sickness spreading; three good harvests left

nodes.label: Ritual of Eternal Dawn
nodes.description: Failed ritual that redirected solar energy into ten living hosts (the Dawnborn); completing it requires releasing that energy, killing them

nodes.label: The Dawnborn
nodes.description: Ten people born the night the ritual failed who are living anchor-points holding the ritual energy; killing them completes the ritual

nodes.label: Grey Sickness
nodes.description: Disease spreading through Varenhold due to perpetual twilight; three-stage progression; affects crops and people

nodes.label: Dawnborn Consent Arc
nodes.description: Each of the ten Dawnborn has a different relationship to consent: Sera willing, Lira has daughter and refuses, Tomas writing will, Cormac reconsidering, Ysel waiting for someone to verify her consent was free

nodes.label: Archmagister Corven
nodes.description: Killed in the Ritual of Eternal Dawn fifty years ago; his documents reveal the true nature of what happened

nodes.label: Three Alternative Paths
nodes.description: Session 3 decision point: Transfer Method (Isolde), Tomas Asymmetry (five surge-phase Dawnborn), Inversion Pathway (all ten freely consent)

nodes.label: Inversion Pathway
nodes.description: If all ten Dawnborn freely consent without coercion, ritual inverts: sun returns, no one dies; hardest ending requiring genuine trust

nodes.label: Transfer Method
nodes.description: Isolde's method: move anchor energy into constructed vessels; 15-20% chance one or two Dawnborn die anyway

nodes.label: Tomas Asymmetry
nodes.description: Five surge-phase Dawnborn carry double load; five could complete the ritual saving the other five; requires identifying and asking the five

nodes.label: Five Endings (A-E)
nodes.description: A=Willing Sacrifice, B=Inversion (all consent/no deaths), C=Transfer (15-20% risk), D=Refusal (city stays dark), E=Cascade Failure (Reckoning forces, all ten die, ritual fails)

nodes.label: Primer Stone
nodes.description: Artifact at Ashring ritual site revealed in Session 4; discloses the Inversion Pathway

nodes.label: Ashring Ritual Site
nodes.description: Primary ritual location; scorched stone circle; convergence point in Session 4; site of the final ritual in Session 5

nodes.label: Plot Overview
nodes.description: Campaign design document by Graeme Sherwood / theGreatGM; logline, world summary, dilemma, arcs, paths, endings, GM job

edges.note: Ostenveld's strategic ignorance mirrors player choice to take job without asking cost — both are consent-adjacent avoidance
Reckoning forcing the ritual maps to Ending E (Cascade Failure)

hyperedges.label: Dawnborn-Ritual-Ashring Convergence
hyperedges.description: The Dawnborn are living anchor-points (Lux Anchor) for the Ritual of Eternal Dawn; the Ashring site is where their energy must be released or redirected; all five endings branch from this nexus
